scope_note: Eora1 26 · basic prices. Locally verified native sets for 1990–2003, 2005–2017: 189 retained regions and 26 sectors. The 2017 inventory was parsed with MARIO; other locally held years were checked for source files and matching labels, not fully parsed. The publisher covers 1990–2023; 2004 and 2018–2023 are not available on this website. The 2016 local copy lacks labels_VA.txt; its VA matrix has the 2017 shape, so parsing that year requires indeces= pointing to a complete common label folder. Scope metadata only; numerical indicators are not published.
